invocation_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd __LOCAL_HOME__/Projects/JavaProjects/docweave
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/lib
for version in 21 25; do
 if [ "$version" = 21 ]; then export JAVA_HOME=/tmp/docweave-jdk21; else export JAVA_HOME=__LOCAL_HOME__/.sdkman/candidates/java/25.0.4-amzn; fi
 export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:__LOCAL_HOME__/.sdkman/candidates/maven/current/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
 for preference in false true; do
  stem="/tmp/docweave-scan-preference-${preference}-java${version}"
  mvn -B -ntp -o -Dmaven.repo.local=/tmp/docweave-m2 -pl docweave-validation -am test -Dtest=PdfPhysicalScanCorpusTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.cache=/tmp/docweave-ctdar -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.report="$stem.json" -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.coverage=ALL_PUBLISHED_SAMPLES -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.dpi=150 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.tableDetection=PROVIDER_LAYOUT -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutModel=/tmp/docweave-table-models/structure-all/structure.onnx -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutSha256=ff1d19a18cb5f041c1692ff681f891a5180f9430d68a71d2cf7a0a2e8e55b990 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.detectionModel=/tmp/docweave-table-models/detection/detection.onnx -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.detectionSha256=0f625baa8849eff26e265ce08a2f6b1479e73f52edd5adc09799c7e7fcc689b9 -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.orientation=true -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.layoutMergeConflicts=KEEP_HIGHER_SCORE -Ddocweave.pdf.scans.preferRuled="$preference" -Ddocweave.tesseract.executable=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/bin/tesseract -Ddocweave.tesseract.tessdata=/tmp/docweave-tesseract-runtime/usr/share/tessdata > "$stem.log" 2>&1
  echo "Completed $stem"
 done
done
